bridge.en: Later, in Chen. Someone waiting for grain asks whether the old claim still counts. The doorkeeper turns toward the council room for an answer.
bridge.zh-Hans: 后来，陈地。领粮的人问旧凭记还算不算数。守门的人回头望向议事处，等里面答话。

text.en: You chose to build ties with the villages before reaching for more territory. At the council door, a village representative stops with one foot over the threshold. “If we agree to supply you today, who do we come to tomorrow?” Someone inside calls him to take his place. He waits for an answer before moving.
text.zh-Hans: 你先前选了从乡里立约，不急着多取城邑。议事处门槛上，一名乡里管事停住脚：“今天答应供粮，明天有事找谁？”屋里叫他入席，他却等着听一个名字。

text.en: You chose to hurry toward Chen. Now a man carrying a grain tally asks where the next column is to assemble. No one at the table answers at once. He stays by the door; the men outside are waiting for him to return. Reaching the city has not settled who may give the next order.
text.zh-Hans: 你先前催着往陈走。如今一个拿着粮筹的人来问，下一队该在哪里集合。案前一时没人回答。他停在门边，外面的人还等他回话。赶到了城里，下一道令由谁来下，却还没说定。

text.en: You chose to send envoys along two roads. At the table, someone asks whose name should be put on any message sent after them. Another reaches for a blank slip, then stops. No new reply has arrived in this scene; the council must first decide what its own word is worth.
text.zh-Hans: 你先前遣人分问两路。案前有人问，若再追送一封信，该署谁的名。旁边的人拿起空简，又停了手。这一幕还没有带来新的回信；先得说清，从这里送出去的话算谁的承诺。

text.en: Here you set policy for the council's leading side, not crowning the keeper himself. These counterfactual choices leave lasting promises and costs. Later you return to those carrying them out.
text.zh-Hans: 此幕由你替议事主事一方定策，不是让掌简人登上王位。反事实选择的承诺与代价会保留，随后回到执行者视角。

bridge.en: The council's decisions reach a northern envoy. Before meeting the people from the city, he unfolds the document once more. It says what was agreed in Chen. It cannot tell him which of the soldiers waiting here will obey him.
bridge.zh-Hans: 陈地议定的文书传到北方使者手里。去见城里来的人之前，他又展开看了一遍。上面写着陈地答应了什么，却没有告诉他，眼前哪些士卒肯听他的话。

text.en: You now act through an entrusted envoy outside Fan Yang. The keeper and the Chen households have not travelled here with the camera. Council decisions shape the support behind this mission; the inherited meters represent that support, not one storehouse shared across distant places. The envoy can negotiate, make a limited commitment, or withdraw—not command every army.
text.zh-Hans: 现在由你通过受托使者在范阳城外交涉。掌简人与陈地家户没有随着视角一起抵达北方。议事决定影响这次差事得到的支持；继承数值表示这种支持，不是两地共用同一座粮仓。使者可以交涉、作出有限承诺或退回，不能号令所有军队。
